notes: All nine records Derived; the native/ordinary seam stays explicit everywhere it is load-bearing: 1/0 undefined in the field yet native as recognition-direction, 4+2 as counted field, native recognition operators not reducible fractions.

Rework 2026-10-07 (craft lane 4): word-labels replaced by drawn derivation. The centre of the journey is the mandala plate rebuilt as drawn geometry: three concentric rings carrying parent slash, sixfold body and return-switch, the six determination signs placed at hexagon vertices, a vortex pin walking the circuit. Each derivation step is an ascii plate of the record's own construction (the fold, the B×B grid, the fused Ø, the 4-3-5 perpendicular, the two Spanda chains).

Colour: five pair-grounds — derivation blue, mandala violet, re-entry jade, orientation brass-dark, Spanda ember. Tints travel; gold at earned returns (the fold, the return-switch, i⁴z=z, the audible family).
Stillness: four of eight adjacent pairs hold field, engine, view and morph (the pairs within each ground); motion at the ground changes and inside the mandala's vortex walk.
Stage text 57 words across nine scenes.
